name: Mai Ha wine
summary: Named on the Phú Thọ tourism list. The 2019 feature calls it a Thai wine made from forest leaves, drunk with trâu gác bếp. No strength is printed. Mai Hạ is also the name of a commune from 2025. The wine name is older than that commune.
origin: The Phú Thọ tourism list and the 26 Aug 2019 Vĩnh Long feature.
howToEat: With the smoked buffalo, on the 2019 feature. The hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Ruou Mai Ha — Thai leaf wine with smoked buffalo
